<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Transgender rights legislation:</strong> The Rajya Sabha has passed the Transgender Persons Amendment Bill, 2026, marking a significant legislative milestone for national inclusivity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOS1Y3RmZzYUVKcWZEU082Q3J2S210X3k5NEVLdmVkbTY2TlBsNFZIR2FoWFBrQTFaMDYwcXE3clIzTDN4VV83US1LUmxwd2FVeVZsNW5YeVZHU0ZMUnJLZjhTVjBnRFE2Y2ZpZTMtOWVqYU1TX3BNTHRvZjhscE1yT1JsRjVFYnFITm9GbVVkNEdkVjFrSTNvYldVUU1zSjlGaVZoZDE3T0x1Vmx5VW5ONnNvc0xxQU5kTlkw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP candidate selection:</strong> The Uttar Pradesh BJP core committee has shortlisted 25 candidates, including Smriti Irani and Hardeep Puri, for upcoming Rajya Sabha and MLC elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> The Chief Election Commissioner is facing mounting political pressure and protests from Congress over the alleged removal of 130 million names from national voter lists.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOZ2UzRk1XQU1xVERxd3hqYVNUN1pSbG1qbktlRVBFbkh4WmUtNTN2ZzdpNjBLUXNHUlE0VDBVbkJaeURVdG5iSjE2YVNzcllWNkdwZGtrZUFJTGFGMkFYTWpORGU5aUxNcy1JdEJnWFg1aUg1TklHdXYzLWxEN0tuYlRrc08tWlphYzg1REZ6alc3d0ZxQlVhWXZYcTZQZUw4aFMw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Education policy intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the CBSE to exempt Class VI students from the mandatory three-language education policy for the current academic year.</li>
  <li><strong>Digital payment regulation:</strong> The Supreme Court has declined to stay the UPI Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) fee, ordering the Centre and RBI to provide a formal response on the matter.</li>
</ul>
